properties.evidence: Document-as-truth rests on hydrate being faithful. This measures that it IS — 3,140/3,140 nodes and 13,167/13,390 edges unchanged, the 223 differences all one materialised default, converging to a fixed point on the second pass. So the risk it names is bounded and one-time rather than fatal: a single normalising migration, not compounding drift. It is filed as a risk rather than a clearance because the same measurement did NOT test whether accumulated store state outside the design survives the trip, which is the way this model would fail late.
